args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming
banker's rounding. The nightly test suite (tests/test_money.py) expects
half-even behavior (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66). Switch the
quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` had a bug: `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring (and the FIN-212 requirement) called for banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This changed the outcome for exactly-half values at the cent boundary (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`), causing the nightly test `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail.

## Change
- Switched the `quantize` call in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so:
  - `2.675` -> `2.68` (odd cent, rounds up)
  - `2.665` -> `2.66` (even cent, rounds down — banker's rounding)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

@alex for review.
